item.title: Suspect in weekend Moore County double killings transferred back from Ohio, deputies say
item.description: A man accused of the Valentine's Day killing of his former girlfriend and a Fort Bragg soldier was extradited to Moore County on Wednesday after deputies said he was captured in Ohio.

item.title: Boyfriend enters Alford plea in NC court for murder of Allisha Watts from Moore County
item.description: According to court records, 52-year-old James Wendell Dunmore pleaded guilty under Alford to voluntary manslaughter and failure to report a death by other than natural causes.
